how: Each flagged row re-run on Google Maps (place page or list, 2026-11-24), then one web search or the operator's own page. Yellowstone park dining checked by name against the NPS Operating Dates page (Winter 2026-27 / Summer 2027 table) and Yellowstone National Park Lodges' dining pages; seasonal places kept with the season in why (both languages). 'Temporarily closed' with no reopening date found = removed.

rows.name: Wise Boys
rows.evidence: Maps list for 'Wise Boys Burgers Auckland': 'Wise Boys Burgers Grey Lynn … 604 Great N Rd · Permanently closed' but 'Wise Boys Burgers Downtown … Commercial Bay 7 Queen St · Closed · Opens 11 AM'. The flagged place is the closed Grey Lynn shop; the row now points at the open Commercial Bay shop (area, what and q updated).

rows.name: Roberta’s at Domino Park
rows.evidence: Maps place page 'Roberta's', 6 Grand St, Brooklyn NY 11249 (One South First, robertaspizza.com): 'Permanently closed'.

rows.name: Starbucks Reserve Roastery
rows.evidence: Maps: 'Starbucks Reserve Roastery, 1124 Pike St · Permanently closed'. KIRO 7 / Capitol Hill Seattle Blog: Starbucks permanently closed the Pike Street roastery on 25 Sep 2025.

rows.name: Old Faithful Inn Dining Room
rows.evidence: Maps 'Temporarily closed' (winter). NPS Operating Dates: Winter 2026-27 closed, Summer 2027 Apr 30 – Oct 11. why already says 'open about May to early October'.

rows.name: Obsidian Dining Room
rows.evidence: Maps 'Temporarily closed' (between seasons). NPS: winter Dec 16, 2026 – Mar 7, 2027; summer 2027 Apr 23 – Oct 31. why already says 'open in summer and winter, shut between the seasons'.

rows.name: Lake Yellowstone Hotel Dining Room
rows.evidence: NPS: winter closed, summer 2027 May 14 – Oct 10. why already names the season (mid-May to early October).

rows.name: Roosevelt Lodge Dining Room
rows.evidence: NPS: winter closed, summer 2027 Jun 4 – Sep 6. why already says 'open June to early September only'.

rows.name: Yellowstone Pizza Company
rows.evidence: Maps place page 'Yellowstone Pizza Company, 210 Park St, Gardiner, MT': 'Temporarily closed'. Its own site (yellowstonegardinerpizzacompany.com) gives no season or reopening date; Visit Montana lists it as open all year, so this is not a known seasonal break — no reopening date found.

rows.name: Old Faithful Lodge Cafeteria
rows.evidence: NPS: winter closed, summer 2027 May 7 – Oct 3; lodges site 2026 May 8 – Oct 3. why already names the season.

rows.name: Canyon Lodge Eatery
rows.evidence: Maps 'Canyon Eatery' temporarily closed (winter). NPS: Canyon Lodge Eatery winter closed, summer 2027 May 14 – Oct 31. why already names the season.

rows.name: Old Faithful Lodge Bake Shop
rows.evidence: Maps landed on the Old Faithful Lodge Cafeteria (no separate pin for the bake shop). The bake shop exists by name: Yellowstone National Park Lodges' page 'old-faithful-lodge-cafeteria-bake-shop' (2026: May 8 – Oct 4) and NPS 'Bake Shop (Old Faithful Lodge)' winter closed, summer 2027 May 7 – Oct 3. why already names the season.

rows.name: Lake Lodge Cafeteria
rows.evidence: Maps landed on 'Lake Lodge Cabins' (a hotel), not the cafeteria. NPS lists the cafeteria as 'Lake Lodge Wylie's Canteen (cafeteria)': winter closed, summer 2027 Jun 10 – Oct 3 (lodges site 2026: Jun 10 – Oct 4). Same counter in the same lodge under its current name: row renamed 'Wylie's Canteen (Lake Lodge)', q updated, season added to why.

rows.name: Mammoth Terrace Grill
rows.evidence: Maps 'Terrace Grill' temporarily closed. NPS and the lodges' dining page: Terrace Grill open April 24 – October 12, 2026; winter closed. Season added to why.

rows.name: Bear Paw Deli
rows.evidence: Maps 'Old Faithful Inn Bear Paw Deli' temporarily closed. NPS: winter closed, summer 2027 Apr 30 – Oct 11. Season added to why.

rows.name: Geyser Grill (Snow Lodge)
rows.evidence: Maps temporarily closed (between seasons). NPS: winter Dec 15, 2026 – Mar 15, 2027; summer 2027 Apr 16 – Oct 31. Season added to why.

rows.name: Grant Village Dining Room
rows.evidence: Maps temporarily closed. NPS: winter closed, summer 2027 May 28 – Oct 10. Season added to why.

rows.evidence: Maps 'The Original Rainbow Cone, 600 E Grand Ave, Located in: Navy Pier · Temporarily closed'. Time Out Chicago: a summer ice-cream stand at Navy Pier; Patch lists the Navy Pier stand as closed for winter while the Beverly shop stays open. Season added to why.

rows.evidence: Maps 'Tatte Bakery & Cafe | Charles St, 70 Charles St · Temporarily closed'. Tatte's own location page: the Charles Street café 'is undergoing an exciting renovation to create a bigger, better space', pointing to other cafés, no reopening date.

rows.name: Ray's Waterfront
rows.evidence: Maps temporarily closed (winter). Row already says 'summer only' and 'open about April to September'.

rows.evidence: Maps temporarily closed. Its own site pizzapietalkeetna.com: 'Yes, we are open year round!' with Facebook posts 'Last day for pizza until 11/21!' and 'Mountain High will reopen This Saturday 12-8' — a short November break, not a closure.

rows.evidence: Maps 'Wild Scoops, 429 E St' temporarily closed. wildscoops.com: Downtown Scoop Shop, 429 E St 'Closed for the season'; Midtown Scoop Shop, 530 E Benson Blvd open daily 12–9 (annual November break 11/2–11/27). Season and the Midtown shop added to why.

rows.name: The Bake Shop
rows.evidence: Maps place page 'The Bake Shop, 194 Olympic Mountain Loop, Girdwood': 'Temporarily closed'. No reopening date found: its own site thebakeshop.com answered 503 Service Unavailable on 2026-11-24; a 2026 Tripadvisor review describes an unannounced closure; no news of a seasonal break. Unsure — may be a shoulder-season break; re-add if it reopens.

rows.name: Hot Licks Homemade Ice Cream
rows.evidence: Maps temporarily closed (winter). Row's what already says 'summer only' (Lonely Planet / Peter Greenberg: open about May to August/September).

rows.name: Mugg & Bean (Lower Sabie)
rows.evidence: Maps place page 'Mugg & Bean @ Lower Sabie, Lower Sabie Rest Camp': 'Permanently closed'. Time Out SA (Oct 2026): Kruger's camp restaurants are getting new operators.

rows.name: Tindlovu Restaurant (Letaba)
rows.evidence: Maps 'Tindlovu Restaurant @ Letaba Rest Camp · Temporarily closed'. SANParks / Tourism Update (Jul 2026): the Letaba restaurant stayed closed after the January 2026 floods, only the 'Tindlovu on the Go' takeaway open; no reopening date.

rows.name: Tindlovu Restaurant (Berg-en-Dal)
rows.evidence: Maps 'Tindlovu Restaurant Berg-En-Dal Rest Camp · Permanently closed'. SANParks' new restaurant operators: the Berg-en-Dal Tindlovu is to become Eziko Eatery (renamed into another business).
